latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of tvdr-video — edit and export video clips with AI.

- Upload MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM files up to 500MB for fast, automated video editing.
- Describe your editing needs (trim silence, add transitions, etc.) and receive processed video in 1–2 minutes.
- Supports credit-based usage via a free token (100 free credits, valid 7 days).
- Session management and streamlined API calls for automatic, easy cloud processing.
- Designed for content creators and marketers seeking quick, shareable video edits without learning complex software.
